## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Duplicate adoption output should be fixed because adopting an existing setting now emits the same progress message twice.

## Changes
The pull request adds adoption records and audit metadata to settings plans, retaining adoption progress and excluding audit records from command output.

(none)

## Important
- app/planner.py:9 — correctness — Emit each adoption message only once — Calling `run({"theme": "dark"}, {"theme": "dark"}, emit)` emits `"Adopted theme"` twice. The planner emits progress immediately, then the new adoption record reaches the renderer at `app/cli.py:9`, which emits it again. — When adopting an existing setting, command users receive duplicate progress messages, making one adoption appear to occur twice. — Fix: Skip adoption records in `app/cli.py:7` while retaining planner progress, and extend `test_adoption_progress` to exercise `run`.
